# What can you bid and still make money?

> Auction car flip calculator for dealers and flippers. Enter resale price, repairs, the auction's buyer fee tiers, transport, tax and holding costs to get the max bid, the break-even bid, and a stress table for repair overruns and a lower resale. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
